title: Naturality of normalized common-stage evaluation
statement: Let l be prime, Ω an algebraic closure of Q_l, and X a scheme on whose residue fields l is invertible. Use the common-stage category C, tensor T, permitted-pair predicate J, and internal-Hom functor H of [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients, def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. Let S be partial closed data [def-pod-partial-closed-interfaces] satisfying the finite rational normalization of [def-sf-adic-closed-reindexing-maps]. For permitted pairs P=(M,N), Q=(M′,N′) and any pair arrow g=(v^op,w):P→Q, right evaluation satisfies T(H(g),1_M′) ≫ ev_Q = T(1_H(P),v) ≫ ev_P ≫ w. This is an equation of actual common-stage classes and holds for all pair morphisms, including representatives with denominators.

source.place: Definition 3.4.10, Lemma 3.4.11, Proposition 6.8.14 and Remark 6.8.15; agent-written common-field representative argument, refining step 6 of lem-sf-adic-common-stage-hom-transpose.

proof.text: Evaluation is inverse transpose of the identity. Use the given normalization to represent both evaluations at one common finite field containing the pair entries, tensor objects, Hom objects and both components of g. The defining common-stage functor formulas express tensor and Hom maps using the rational maps conjugated by their specified comparisons. Apply normalized rational evaluation naturality at that field and cancel adjacent comparisons. Equality of representatives implies equality of classes. The normalization holds after every further enlargement, so the formula uses the specified evaluations and no transition map need be injective.
